name: – § 4 – Am 5
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the evaluation of the Common Fisheries Policy and follow-up
part_text: 4.Regrets the lack of implementation of the landing obligation, particularly in mixed fisheries and in situations where choke species generate disproportionate socio-economic consequences; stresses that in the case of a serious threat to the conservation of marine resources, the Commission may take emergency measures, including temporary closures of fisheries; calls on the Commission to address these shortcomings by proposing alternative management tools and solutions, making full use of the possibilities offered by artificial intelligence, alongside greater flexibility, including improved quota-management tools, by-catch mitigation, quota pools, real-time closures, exchanges between Member States and producer organisations, and other appropriate measures, while maintaining the overall objectives of the landing obligation;
